statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent syncope
The patient has paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is ordered for ambulatory evaluation
The service is medically necessary to identify the arrhythmia responsible for the patient's symptoms (R55)
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
